videos.title: The 2027 Standard Deduction Just Went Up
videos.description: For tax year 2027, the IRS raised the standard deduction to $16,600 for single filers (up $500), $24,925 for heads of household and $33,200 for married couples filing jointly (Rev. Proc. 2026-35, Nov 5, 2026). Educational only, not financial advice. #standarddeduction #personalfinance #shorts

videos.title: No Investors, $12 Billion: The Mailchimp Story
videos.description: Mailchimp began in 2001 as a side project at an Atlanta web design agency and never raised venture capital. In 2021, Intuit agreed to buy it for $12 billion in cash and stock. #mailchimp #bootstrapping #shorts
